spec.name: Blend v37
spec.notes: Combined signal, rebalanced on a slow schedule.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 2.4, annual return 13%, maximum drawdown 5%.

exhibits.summary: Delaying the signal by 1 more bar moves the Sharpe ratio from 2.37 to -0.21 (change -2.58).
Under strict point-in-time data the Sharpe ratio moves from 2.37 to 2.37. Strict mode changed no field or operator the signal uses.
At 10 bps the Sharpe ratio is -0.15 (as submitted, 0 bps: 2.37); it breaks even at 9.4 bps with daily turnover 0.56.
On the full universe the Sharpe ratio is 2.37 against 2.37 as submitted; the strategy never saw 0 delisted assets.
On the sealed period (strict mode, 10 bps) the Sharpe ratio is -1.22 against 2.37 in research, a gap of +3.60.
The best year gives 19% of total P&L (year 8) and calm regimes give 74%; Sharpe is 2.71 in calm and 1.95 in stressed regimes.
The log holds 4 distinct specs; the best of 4 under no edge is expected to reach a Sharpe of 0.35, so the claimed 2.40 becomes 2.05 and the probability that the true Sharpe is above zero is 100%.
The real signal's gross Sharpe of 2.38 beats 100% of 200 shuffled signals (shuffled mean -0.05, 95th percentile 0.49).
Perturbing the 3 numeric values in the signal by up to 50% moves the Sharpe ratio from 2.37 to as low as 1.85 (as low as 2.20 at 25%).
The top 1% of days (23 days) give 28% of total P&L and the top 5 assets give 14% (net of the strategy's own costs).

series.label: cumulative share of P&L, best days first

exhibits.summary: The scan (a heuristic) found no phrase addressed to reviewers or giving instructions in 2 text sources.

verdict.opinion: Rejected: core test damaging (lag_test EX-1, cost_test EX-3, holdout_test EX-5).
